end.summary:
Explored levels of organisation using human, plant, and house examples.
Yash identified several examples: red blood cell—cell, xylem—tissue, leaf—organ, nervous system—organ system, whole house—organism.
Explained that roots are needed for water to reach leaves and that vessels are needed for blood to reach the legs; this remains to be checked next time.
The organ versus organ system mix-up remained: Yash continued to treat the heart and circulatory system as the same.
end.parentNote: Asha practised levels of organisation with Yash through human, plant, and house examples. Yash gave several correct examples and recognised that the heart needs blood vessels as a route, although the difference between an organ and an organ system still needs checking. At home, practise sorting examples into cell, tissue, organ, organ system, and organism, then ask what parts work together in each system.

Haan, aapne ghar ke parts ko levels se sahi milaya, aur ek important farq bhi pakda: eent zinda nahi hoti, cell zinda hoti hai aur divide kar sakti hai. Ghar wali misaal sirf parts ke milkar banne ko samjhati hai, living cheezon ke saare kaam nahi. Ab body mein dil aur blood vessels milkar kya kaam karte hain jo dil akela nahi kar sakta?
dil pump karta hai, vessels bhi... woh bhi pump mein help karte hain? lekin dil hi toh main hai, vessels toh bas pipes hain... toh dil akela bhi kar sakta hai na, vessels ke bina bhi?

Aap pooch rahe hain, dil main pump hai toh kya woh akela kaafi hai. Sochiye, nal se paani nikle par pair tak koi pipe na ho: paani wahan kaise pahunchega? Dil khoon ko dhakelta hai, aur blood vessels uske raaste hain. Vessels na hon toh khoon pair tak pahunchega kya?

nahi... nahi pahunchega, kyonki raasta hi nahi hai. toh dil akela kaafi nahi hai, vessels bhi chahiye. lekin ma'am, homework mein ek question tha ki tissue aur organ mein kya difference hai, woh batao na?

Haan, raasta na ho toh khoon pair tak nahi pahunchega; dil aur vessels dono chahiye. Homework ke liye farq aise sochiye: muscle tissue mein milti-julti cells ek kaam karti hain, jabki dil ek organ hai jisme alag tissues milkar pump karte hain. Toh dil ko sirf muscle tissue kyon nahi kahenge?
